title: kate-core: Document, View, Workspace arena, incremental re-highlight, command table
summary: The editor model as one owning tree. Workspace owns SlotMaps of Document and View plus a SplitTree layout; a Document owns its TextBuffer, History, file state and per-line syntax cache; a View owns Selections and scroll state and points at a DocumentId. Edits go through Workspace::execute(view, Command), which applies the transaction, records history, transforms every view's selections on that document, and marks the syntax cache dirty from the first changed line. The GUI renders this and calls execute; it never touches a buffer directly.

lane.reason: Integrates four crates through their public APIs with no GUI. The integration tests are the first end-to-end tests of the editor model and must run on Linux CI as well as macOS.

definitions.definition:
/// Everything a key binding, a menu item, a script or a plugin can ask for. The only mutation entry point.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum Command {
    InsertText(String), Newline, DeleteBackward, DeleteForward,
    Move(Movement, Extend), SelectAll, AddCursorBelow, AddCursorAbove, RemoveSecondaryCursors,
    Undo, Redo, BeginUndoGroup, EndUndoGroup,
    Save, SaveAs(std::path::PathBuf), Reload,
    SetSyntax(Option<DefId>), ToggleMark(MarkKind, u32),
    Scroll(i32), ScrollTo(u32),
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum CommandError {
    NoFile,                                   // Save on an Untitled document
    Save(kate_fileio::SaveError), Load(kate_fileio::LoadError),
    Apply(kate_text::ApplyError), Transaction(kate_text::TransactionError),
    UnknownView(ViewId),
}

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: New modules; Cargo.toml gains path dependencies on kate-text, kate-fileio (load, save, encoding, BOM, and line endings), kate-syntax (the line highlighter and the syntax repository), and slotmap 1.1.1 (generational arena keys; Vec indices would dangle after close). tempfile 3.27.0 is a dev-dependency for tempfile::tempdir in the save test. Cargo.lock records these kate-core edges. kate-search is not a dependency, and there is no find command yet. A later find packet adds it. The event outbox, drain_events, MoveTo, and CheckDisk are deferred, and disk_change stays None. History undo and redo return ranges, so the workspace keeps the forward transactions mirrored, grouped the same way, to move other views and splice the syntax cache. The syntax cache stores per-line end states, not spans. StateIds belong to one Highlighter. A private dirty_to forces painting through the last edit. It is shifted by the net line delta of earlier edits and kept as a max across partial ensure. An undo dirties one line past the restored region. Newline inserts \n only. tab_width is used for movement. indent_width and indent_with_spaces are stored but not applied. Save cleanup is one Programmatic transaction before mark_saved. It strips first, then adds a final newline only if the last line is non-empty, matching KTextEditor v6.31.0 removeTrailingSpacesAndAddNewLineAtEof, so an empty document stays empty. The ModifiedLines set is remapped in one pass per edit. In other views, carets move past inserted text with right bias, and ranges keep a left anchor and right head. A mixed set is mapped once per kind. Carets at touching edits may merge, as Kate does applying edits one at a time. The primary follows its selection through any merge. Reloading a probably-binary file returns Load InvalidData, and open returns OpenError::ProbablyBinary. new_view on an unknown document returns a null ViewId, and close_view on an unknown id returns Closed. Folds stay empty. A failed invert returns Transaction Overlap{0,0}. SaveAs does not refuse a path that is already open. Public fields can bypass execute. The mark anchor uses left bias. Undo restores ranges without goal_col or direction. A single grapheme or newline is Typing and can merge. A multi-caret edit is Paste and does not merge. Edits snap to grapheme and CRLF boundaries. The syntax oracle runs 4096 cases by default (KATE_SYNTAX_ORACLE_CASES).

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::edit_in_one_view_moves_cursors_in_the_other
regression_tests.asserts: Two views on one document; inserting 3 chars before view B's caret via view A advances B's caret by 3.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::open_edit_save_reload_round_trip_in_tempdir
regression_tests.asserts: Open a CRLF windows-1252 file from tempfile::tempdir(), insert text, Save, read bytes back: CRLF and encoding preserved, history.is_modified() false after save.

regression_tests.name: syntax_cache::tests::rehighlight_stops_when_state_converges
regression_tests.asserts: Editing line 500 of a 10,000-line Rust file re-highlights fewer than 20 lines when the edit does not open a block comment, and all remaining lines when it does.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::close_last_view_of_modified_document_is_refused
regression_tests.asserts: close_view returns RefusedModified for the only view of a modified document and Closed after Save.
